extensionDescription.message: A minimal MP4 download button right in your X feed.

downloadStarted.message: Download started. You can find the file in Firefox downloads.

extensionRestarted.message: The extension restarted. Reload the X page.

reloadPage.message: Reload the X page and try again.

downloadInterrupted.message: Download interrupted. Check Firefox downloads and try again.

linkMissing.message: Video link not found yet. Open the post, reload the page, and try again.

downloadFailed.message: Firefox could not start the download. Reload the post and try again.
